dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Miss, miss! Are those antlers on your head?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Wow, they look just like deer antlers!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: I bet they are! Just like us Frostmoon Scions!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Yeah! Our Lady Moonchanter, Miss Lauma, also has a pair of really pretty antlers!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Umm, I don't fully understand what's going on, but I'm quite sure my horns and hers aren't the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: I know, I know! Miss Lauma's horns go up, and yours go down! Wow... are you also a Moonchanter, miss?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: A M—Moonchanter? Well, I don't think I am...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: (Moonchanter? That's a foreign term to me. I think Granny once mentioned an adeptus who was related to the moon, but I don't think they were a "Moonchanter"... were they...)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: (Oh no, wait. Granny told me not to tell outsiders about adepti... So what should I say to these kids?)

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hmm... But your horns are just as pretty as hers!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Miss, miss! Can you talk to animals like Miss Lauma can?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Let's skip that first. I need you to save me right now... if these kids keep asking me questions, I won't be able to hide my identity as an adeptus for much longer!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Ina. Kari. It's good to be welcoming to our guests, but if you ask too many questions, you may come off as impolite...

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: Ah! Miss Lauma!

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: Mm... Yeah, you're right. Sorry, Long-Horned Miss! We asked too many questions...

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Sorry... It's just that we've never seen someone from outside the Scions with horns, so...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Alright. Come, Ina, Kari. You two should go home. I saw your parents on the way here, they must be worried sick searching for you.

response.speaker: Kari
response.text: Ah! They're searching— Oh no, it's way past dinnertime!

response.speaker: Ina
response.text: We're dead meat! Daddy's going to scold me! Bye bye, Miss Lauma! And bye bye... Long-Horned Miss!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Phew... Thanks for your help, Lauma. I don't know how I would've wriggled out of this otherwise.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: *sigh* I should have stayed in the library to search for information like you advised. Didn't think I'd be ambushed the instant I stepped outside...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: No need to blame yourself, Yanfei. The children are merely curious beyond their years, and unaccustomed to seeing outsiders with horns. I apologize on their behalf for the discourtesy.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It's fortunate that the finches came to tell me you were surrounded by Ina and Kari... It seems my arrival proved timely.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: It's alright! I should have known better...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: That we are. Yanfei came to visit us Frostmoon Scions two days ago, saying that she wished to gather some reading materials. Since she came to study, I invited her to stay.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Hehe, Lauma's been a big help. I've gleaned lots of valuable information from the Scions' library. Maybe even stuff that'll give Shinobu a surprise!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: You're too kind, Yanfei. You were merely browsing our archives and writing down some of our customs.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Although I do not understand these... "borders of law" you mentioned... As long as your time here has proven fruitful, then all is well.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The "borders of law" are essentially... Hmm, on second thought, it's not the sort of thing where a short explanation will suffice. Once the book's done, we'll just send you a few copies. It should be clear once you read it.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: It's a universal law book that should be concise, engaging, informative, and easy to understand. We'll cover legal concepts as well as the regulations present in many nations!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Is that so? Well, then I look forward to reading your work, Yanfei. I believe the children will be interested too.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I promise it'll be interesting! I guess I should head back to the library and continue my transcribing for now. See you both around!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Hehe. I hope our adeptus finds what she's looking for...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yanfei's already revealed her identity to you?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: She told me everything on her first visit. Hehe, I must admit... Seeing an adeptus with horns fills me with a sense of familiarity.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I listened to her many stories of Liyue's adepti, and in exchange, I granted her access to our library.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: In that, she has thus far proved most rule-abiding — a praiseworthy virtue, I must say.

choices.text: Well, she does work as a legal adviser.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Is that so? Well, that's wonderful. Hmm... She did mention a certain white horse adeptus while telling me of Liyue's legends.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: If memory serves, our books do chronicle a divine envoy who once dwelled on the moon.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Now, now. Do not concern yourself overly with a mere flight of fancy on my part.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But now that we have broached the subject... Far apart though Liyue and Nod-Krai might be, both have always bathed in the moonlight...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I pray that the people of Liyue may also be blessed by the moon, and lead lives of peace and prosperity.

choices.text: (Is there such a person among the adepti of Liyue...?)
She's the best at following the rules!
